clips.title: The story
paras: Shadow Priest Sarvis tasks newly awakened Forsaken with culling the Mindless Zombies and Wretched Zombies that wander the northern edges of Deathknell. These shambling corpses are Scourge thralls, devoid of free will and utterly bound to the Lich King's command.

Not all who rise from the dirt of Lordaeron regain their minds. While the Forsaken threw off the mental domination of Ner'zhul when his power waned, countless corpses remain hollow husks chained to his will. In northern Deathknell, these Mindless and Wretched Zombies wander without purpose other than raw violence. For a newly risen undead, putting them down is the first bitter trial of existence—proving one's autonomy by severing the chains of those who never broke free.

Though Shadow Priest Sarvis laments that these vast legions of dead cannot be recruited to bolster the Forsaken's desperate struggle, there is no curing them. The mindless undead are permanently broken instruments of slaughter. Leaving them to roam invites chaos to Deathknell's doorstep and provides the Lich King with easy fodder. Eliminating them is both a tactical necessity and an act of grim finality for Lordaeron's fallen people.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the traveler, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, friend. Do not return until you have success to report.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.
But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
